title: Teradata and Volkswagen Develop Smart Factory Solution for Greater Efficiency in Vehicle Body Construction
summary: Volkswagen’s smart factory “spot welding analytics” solution analyzes data generated by welding robots – a previously untapped source of manufacturing data.
